documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The 2Nd Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Lumax Auto Technologies reported a strong start to FY27 with Q1 revenue growing 33% year-on-year to INR 1,364 crore and EBITDA expanding 51% to INR 205 crore. Management highlighted a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore and outlined several expansion projects including a new Chakan plant for the IAC division, a mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, and a Greenfuel facility in Nashik. The company maintains its long-term '20.20.20.20 Vision' targeting a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031 and inching closer to a 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years. For the near term, management guided to sustain current margin levels achieved in Q1. Lumax Auto Technologies Limited released its investor presentation for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, highlighting consolidated revenues of INR 1,364 crore and a net profit before minority interest of INR 99 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects to be able to sustain the current margins achieved in Q1 for the remaining part of the year.
guidance.quote: On the margin front, I think I can only say that we will be able to sustain these current margins achieved in Q1 for the remaining part of the year as well.

guidance.claim: The guidance for the full year capex continues to remain around INR 300 crore.
guidance.quote: The guidance for the full year continues to remain around INR 300 crore, which will include the upcoming greenfield expansions of Mechatronics as well as new plants of IAC division.

guidance.claim: The share of minority interest is expected to remain in the 11-13% range going forward.
guidance.quote: Going forward, this minority interest will remain in similar range between 11-13%-odd, considering the existing structure which is at the present moment.

guidance.claim: Management aims for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031 and inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.
guidance.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our “20.20.20.20 Vision”, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.

guidance.claim: By FY 2031, the company aspires to more than double its current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore.
guidance.quote: And by FY 2031, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore, fueled by a blend of organic excellence and strategically inorganic opportunities.

guidance.claim: The company targets a minimum of 20% CAGR in revenue under its mid-term plan.
Management has set a vision for a 20% EBITDA margin.
The company targets 20+% from future and clean mobility.
The company expects to continue outperforming industry growth and targets a 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: So overall, I think we continue to be on par with the mid-term strategy of our 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects margins to sustain or increase by at least 30 bps for the full year.
guidance.quote: So for the full year, I do not foresee any reason that the margins would get negatively impacted. On the contrary, I would say, on account of the top line growth, the margin should just sustain or at least further go up by at least 30 bps or so.

guidance.claim: The effective tax rate for FY 26 is 26%, and management expects it to hold at similar levels going forward.
guidance.quote: Excluding the same, the effective tax rate for FY 26 comes out as 26%, and we expect it to hold at similar levels way forward.

guidance.claim: The minority share for FY 26 is 17%, which is expected to remain in a similar range going forward.
guidance.quote: The minority share for FY 26, however, is at 17%, and which is expected to be in a similar range going forward.

guidance.claim: Lumax Ituran's FY 27 guidance projects up to 150 basis points improvement internally.
guidance.quote: However, the FY 27 guidance remains in place for up to 150 basis points improvement as is being projected internally right now.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer demand was resilient, supported by lower GST rates, easier financing, and new model launches.
demand_outlook.quote: The broad-based growth in production was led by lower GST rates, easier financing, new model launches, leading to resilient consumer demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is expected to remain healthy as the festive season is entered, with leading OEMs reporting low inventory levels.
demand_outlook.quote: As we enter the festive season, demand is expected to remain healthy, with many leading OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers) reporting low inventory levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Improved monsoon conditions and stable inflation further supported demand, particularly in rural markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Improved monsoon conditions and stable inflation further supported demand, particularly in the rural markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management is confident to post double-digit growth for the remaining part of the year in the Aftermarket segment.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we are confident to bounce back and confident to post double-digit growth for the remaining part of the year in this particular segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Retail demand remains strong and intact, and the momentum of demand continues into the current Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: However, of course, there are certain input costs and margin pressures. But the demand from a retail point of view, still seems to be intact.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall demand environment and industry outlook continue to be favourable for FY 27.
demand_outlook.quote: In closing, while we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favourable, giving us confidence as we enter FY 27.

demand_outlook.claim: CNG continues to have a very strong pull in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: So CNG continues to have a very strong pull in the market.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant is being set up at Chakan for the IAC division to cater to upcoming demand from Mahindra & Mahindra.
capex_expansion.quote: • A new plant at Chakan for the IAC division to cater to upcoming demand from Mahindra & Mahindra, while simultaneously optimizing product lines between this facility and the existing ones.

capex_expansion.claim: The mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: • The previously announced mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of this year, where we are consolidating four entities, Lumax Yokowo, Lumax Alps Alpine, Lumax Ituran and Lumax FAE, under one roof to optimize resources and fixed costs.

capex_expansion.claim: A new facility will be set up in Nashik at Greenfuel Energy to cater to Mahindra's requirements.
capex_expansion.quote: • At Greenfuel Energy, we are pleased to report that we onboarded Mahindra as a new customer and to cater to their requirements, we shall be setting up a new facility in Nashik.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex during the 1st Quarter was INR 23 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the 1st Quarter was INR 23 crore.

capex_expansion.claim: Q1 FY27 capex stood at INR 23 crore.
Total capex during FY 26 was INR 233 crore, including strategic land investments and capacity expansions.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the year was INR 233 crore, which included strategic investment in land in Gujarat and Kharkhoda Region of INR 45 crore and also almost INR 100 crore on capacity expansions in IAC and Lumax Alps Alpine.

margins_costs.claim: Plastics typically have a back-to-back arrangement with most OEMs, with 80% to 90% realization within the same quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Only for few OEMs, maybe the spillover happens to the next quarter. But I would say to a great extent of 80% to 90%, we get the realization within the same quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Greenfuel division EBITDA margins included a 3%-odd one-off tooling revenue impact of around INR 3 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Ankit Thakral: Yes, correct, sir. Mihir Ji, there was an amount of around INR 3-odd crore specifically for this particular Greenfuel division impacting around 3% on the EBITDA margins, which was one-off as a result of certain tooling revenue, which happened with the existing customer.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for FY 26 reached INR 705 crore with a margin of 14.5%.
margins_costs.quote: The Company also crossed the INR 700 crore mark for EBITDA to reach record EBITDA of INR 705 crore with a healthy margin of 14.5% along with a record PAT of INR 337 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Short-term pressure on margins has arisen due to inflationary costs, minimum wage hikes, and energy prices.
margins_costs.quote: So Amit, most of the inflationary costs, be it on account of raw material commodities or also the manpower cost, which has significantly risen up due to certain minimum wage hikes, also the energy price is going up, all of it has, of course, put some short-term pressure on the margins.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: We are pleased to report a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore, which provides a healthy visibility for the business going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: Approximately 24% of the order book is expected to be executed in FY 27, 56% in FY 28, and the remaining 20% in FY 29.
orders_capacity.quote: Of this order book, approximately 24% is expected to be executed in this FY 27 itself, 56% in FY 28, and the remaining 20% in FY 29.

orders_capacity.claim: Advanced Plastics contributes the largest share of the order book, followed by Mechatronics, Alternate Fuels and Structures and Control systems.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book continues to reflect a healthy traction across all our product verticals, with Advanced Plastics contributing the largest share, followed by Mechatronics, Alternate Fuels and Structures and Control systems.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book stands at INR 787 crore for the Advanced Plastics division.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book remains strong at INR 787 crore for this division, providing solid future visibility.

orders_capacity.claim: The Mechatronics segment has a healthy order book of close to INR 500 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Mechatronics segment sustained its upward momentum, delivering a y-o-y increase of almost 56% in Q1 FY 27 from INR 54 to INR 84 crore, with a very healthy order book of close to INR 500 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The Structure and Control Systems vertical reported an order book of INR 130 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: It reported a y-o-y growth of 21% in Q1, increasing from INR 180 crore to INR 220 crore with an order book of INR 130 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book progresses in stages to achieve full completion by FY29.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book is set to progress in stages achieving full completion by FY29.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates 28 manufacturing plants pan-India.
Cornaglia reported an order book of Rs 94 crores.
Alps Alpine reported an order book of Rs 154 Crores.
The Mechatronics segment grew by almost 150% in FY 26 with an order book of INR 400 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The Mechatronics segment sustained upward momentum, delivering a y-o-y growth of almost 150% in FY 26 from INR 115 crore to INR 281 crore with a healthy order book of INR 400 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term debt stood at INR 508 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.32.
capital_allocation.quote: The long-term debt stood at INR 508 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.32, which is within our internal comfort thresholds.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 396 crore as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of March 2026, we continue to maintain a strong balance sheet and a healthy liquidity position. Free cash reserves stood at INR 396 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains an internal policy of a minimum 35% dividend payout ratio.
capital_allocation.quote: So the payout ratio, we have a very fair internal policy of maintaining a minimum 35% payout ratio and the Company continues to maintain that for the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economy continues to navigate a challenging geopolitical landscape with ongoing conflict in the Middle East, heightening concerns around energy security, supply chain disruptions, and inflationary pressures.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economy continues to navigate a challenging geopolitical landscape with the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, heightening concerns around energy security, supply chain disruptions, and inflationary pressures.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry continues to closely monitor commodity prices, geopolitical developments and supply chain dynamics.
risks_headwinds.quote: The industry continues to closely monitor commodity prices, geopolitical developments and supply chain dynamics that could influence input costs and overall market sentiment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains watchful of macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation, and energy price volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: In closing, while we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favourable, giving us confidence as we enter FY 27.

risks_headwinds.claim: Labour shortages were experienced due to elections or war-related scenarios or other conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: So yes, it is very much a fact and there is no point saying that there are no labour shortages that we have experienced either due to elections or due to the war-related scenario or other conditions.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the Mechatronics division to clock around INR 400 crore of revenue for the full fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: If you look at Mechatronics, I think for the full year, we should be clocking anywhere around INR 400 crore of revenue in this fiscal year as a division.

management_commitments.claim: By FY 2030-31, the company anticipates close to INR 1,000 crore top line from the Mechatronics division.
management_commitments.quote: I think, to me, by FY 2030-31, we should definitely be looking at close to INR 1,000 crore top line from Mechatronics division.

management_commitments.claim: Over the next 12-24 months, the Mechatronics basket will operate between 14-15% EBITDA.
management_commitments.quote: Vikas Marwah: Sure. Just to give you a very satisfactory answer, if you just put them under a Mechatronics bucket, the intended path is that over the next 12-24 months, the Mechatronics basket will be operating in anywhere between 14-15% EBITDA.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a minimum of 20% CAGR in revenue for the mid-term plan spanning FY26 to FY31.
The company will maintain a minimum 35% dividend payout ratio.
management_commitments.quote: So the payout ratio, we have a very fair internal policy of maintaining a minimum 35% payout ratio and the Company continues to maintain that for the year.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: So overall, I think we continue to be on par with the mid-term strategy of our 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: IAC would definitely see an expansion on its OEM customer base over the mid-term plan of 2030.
management_commitments.quote: So I still remain pretty optimistic that over our mid-term plan of 2030, IAC would definitely see an expansion on its OEM customer base.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
